title: Treesa-Gayatri Assured of Medal at World Championships
indian_angle: The unseeded Indian women's doubles pair secured India's first medal at the BWF World Championships by reaching the semifinals.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand defeated China’s Y.F. Jia and S.X. Zhang in the women’s doubles quarterfinal, guaranteeing India a medal at the BWF World Championships.
